name: silverback
description: The shared AGENTS.md ruleset, injected into every session by a SessionStart hook: boundaries, security, a verification gate before any completion claim, the lazy-senior-dev coding ladder, concise communication, commit conventions. On-demand modules in rules/ extend it across the stack and are read only when the task matches. Hooks block destructive commands, ask before a push, a recursive delete, a history rewrite or an edit to agent instruction files, and send back a turn that edited files and ran no check.
